summary: Reverified s1_expert_creativity_editor_vs_human against PDF pp. 2-4, including Table 1 recovered with pymupdf.find_tables(), and the random-assignment description on PDF p. 9. Read the entire 57,080-character markdown conversion in four consecutive chunks, including methods, references and end matter; the document contains no appendix. Table 1 and the results prose confirm treatment mean 12.55, treatment SD 4.32, control mean 18.23, control SD 4.94, and the pairwise p < 0.001. The paper prints 48 participants in each eligible arm and 96 analyzed participants. The null n_units is appropriate: the printed 146-poem collection includes 50 AI-only benchmark poems, and no separate two-arm output total is printed. All requested coding fields are consistent with immediate expert-rated overall creativity of poems produced with assigned AI assistance available, in a between-person AI-versus-unassisted contrast. One poem per participant supports participant-level SDs and se_basis=participant while unit=output describes the analyzed poems. No in-scope outcome or contrast is missing under extraction rules 4-6: Study 1 has one eligible expert-creativity contrast and Study 2 has three, all present. Self-reports, AI-only comparisons and mediation paths do not supply additional eligible outcome contrasts. The paper's inconsistent recruitment arithmetic and omnibus degrees of freedom are documented in the extraction and do not justify replacing the printed counts or pairwise statistics.
